oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:title: North Hall ca. 1886
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:creator: [Unknown]
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:description: Completed in 1869, North Hall was the first building constructed for the new Atlanta University. When first compleded it provided dormitory rooms for both men and women students as well as providing classroom space.
